title: yadakchi.clusters.changed.v1
description:
The set of offers matcher believes describe one physical product.

Producers: matcher. Consumers: catalog.
Kafka message key: cluster_uid — it must be set; compaction and partition ordering depend on it.
Cleanup: delete, retention 90 days.

This file validates a whole Kafka message body: the shared envelope from docs/specs/02-EVENT-CONTRACTS.md plus this topic's payload. Unknown fields are ignored, never rejected, at both levels — that is what lets a producer add an optional field without breaking a consumer.

event_id.description: UUIDv4, unique per emission. Two emissions of the same fact carry different event_ids; consumers deduplicate on the payload's natural identity, not on this.

event_type.description: The topic name without the 'yadakchi.' prefix and without the version suffix.

version.description: Envelope and payload version. A removed field, a renamed field or a changed type is a breaking change: publish to .v2 and run both until consumers migrate.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, ISO-8601 UTC with Z. Consumers tolerate out-of-order delivery across partitions by comparing this, never by assuming global ordering.

producer.description: The service that emitted this message. Constrained to the producers declared for this topic in platform/kafka/topics.yml.

trace_id.description: Propagated across the whole chain for debugging. Minted by crawler on yadakchi.listings.observed.v1 and carried through every derived event; a service starting a chain of its own (a human admin edit, a scheduled recomputation) mints a fresh one. Every service logs it.

payload.description: cluster_uid is minted by matcher as a UUIDv4 and is stable for the life of the cluster; catalog adopts it unchanged as product_uid. A cluster_uid is never silently dropped — a retired cluster carries successor_uid and the clusters that replace it list it in predecessor_uids, which catalog turns into 301 redirects. This topic is not compacted, so payload is never null; there is no tombstone on a delete-retention topic.

cluster_uid.description: UUIDv4 minted by matcher. catalog adopts it as product_uid unchanged.

members.description: The offers in this cluster, with how confident matcher is about each membership.

provenance.description: How the membership was decided. human always wins over a computed value.

predecessor_uids.description: Clusters this one absorbed, or the cluster it was split out of. Empty on creation.

successor_uid.description: Set when this cluster is retired, pointing at the cluster that replaces it. null while the cluster is live.
